Context: 5. Relaxations.-

## 5. Relaxations.-  
- (i) Age.Maximum age-limit may be relaxed wherever necessary, but no relaxation is permissible in the minimum limit of 18 years. If the ward is below 18 years of age at the time of death of the Government servant and if he alone is available for employment, he should apply as soon as he attains 18 years.
